method: Opened final exported PDF rasterized by Poppler, not an HTML screenshot. Inspected full page and listed close-ups.

views.finding: Full final PDF: three independent columns and unchanged author/header hierarchy.
All three column bottoms and footer: closing group stays in Column 3, no overlap or clipping, useful whitespace.
Three prominent findings immediately followed by one quieter limitations block, exact supplied text, 24-pt body.
Both years, all native bins and unknown, legend/count scale and accounting preserved; labels remain readable.
Author names, IDs, order, subtitle and affiliation unchanged.
Manufacturing and country-specific service trends, units and source notes preserved.
Unchanged plot dimensions and intervals; hollow/filled explanation and denominator qualification readable.
National trends and all-region distribution: full numeric ranges and labels retained.
Direct country labels, separate panels and open/filled markers remain interpretable without hue.

inspection_crops: Local QA PNGs are reproducible inspection aids excluded from the intended file list.
